test_name: Physical and Environmental Protection - PE-6 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Grants-Workflow-104
Primary NIST family: Physical and Environmental Protection (PE); evidence focus: PE-6.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: physical access authorization is role-based and reconciled against active personnel. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
